primary_logo.description: Centered composition with a stylized green lightning bolt rising from layered teal/green leaves, framed by a golden sun arc and small floral/eco icons. Below the emblem is the word 'EnerGenius' in rounded, bold green sans-serif, and under that the words 'RENEWABLE RESOURCE GROUP' in black all-caps sans-serif.
key_elements: Central vertical lightning bolt in medium green
Symmetrical leaf shapes in gradient teal/green forming a base
Golden arc above with star and small yellow/teal floral icons
'EnerGenius' wordmark in rounded, bold green sans-serif
Subline 'RENEWABLE RESOURCE GROUP' in black uppercase sans-serif
intended_usage: Website hero and main product banners
Large prints where full text is legible

typography.wordmark_font_style: Rounded, friendly sans-serif similar to Nunito / Poppins SemiBold.
typography.subline_font_style: Simple geometric sans-serif in all caps for 'RENEWABLE RESOURCE GROUP'.

secondary_logo.role: Compact EnerGenius secondary mark for small or constrained spaces
secondary_logo.concept: A simplified circular badge using the same emblem (lightning bolt + leaves + sun arc) with the 'EnerGenius' wordmark either wrapped around the circle or set tightly beneath it, and no 'Renewable Resource Group' subline.

layout_variants.description: Circular or soft-rounded badge containing the emblem centered. Around the bottom curve of the circle, small uppercase text reads 'EnerGenius' or 'EnerGenius Solar'. No company subline.
usage: Small corner bug on product imagery

layout_variants.description: Emblem on the left, 'EnerGenius' wordmark on the right in a single line. No small floral icons outside the emblem; simplified for clarity. No 'Renewable Resource Group' text.
usage: Header lockup where vertical space is limited

visual_alignment_rules: Reuse the exact emblem forms (leaves, lightning bolt, arc, small icons) from the primary logo so they are immediately recognizable as the same brand.
Keep the same green and gold palette as the primary logo; minor balancing adjustments (e.g., slightly less shadow/gradient) are allowed to improve legibility at small sizes.
Remove the 'RENEWABLE RESOURCE GROUP' subline in secondary uses to keep the mark clean.
Maintain rounded, friendly sans-serif for 'EnerGenius' to stay consistent with the primary wordmark.
Use white or very light backgrounds wherever possible for maximum contrast.
